bias.zh: 上升趋势修复中 · 逼近 30 日均线

read.en: AMD rose 3.2% on Oct 28 to $578.44, trading between $560.52 and $579.11. It is above the falling 5-day ($538.9) and 10-day ($541.1) averages and the rising 100-day ($528.0) and 200-day ($407.4), and just below the rising 30-day ($587.8). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9 and below zero, histogram narrowing toward a cross; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 27 ($503.83), and RSI is 54.
read.zh: AMD 10月28日上涨 3.2%，收于 $578.44，盘中区间 $560.52–579.11。股价位于下行的 5 日（$538.9）和 10 日均线（$541.1）以及上行的 100 日（$528.0）和 200 日均线（$407.4）上方，略低于上行的 30 日均线（$587.8）。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄并接近交叉；抛物线 SAR 自 10月27日起看多（$503.83），RSI 为 54。

read.en: The close cleared $563.9–568.6 (Oct 27 and Oct 15 highs), now support; the $579.1 high stopped short of the 30-day. Resistance is $584.7–587.8 (Jun 30 high, 30-day), then $591.9 (Oct 14 high) and $606.2 (Oct 13 high). Support is $560.5–568.6, then $538.9–541.1 (5 and 10-day) and $528 (100-day). A close above $587.8 would target $592–606; below $560, $540.

s.en: Oct 27 high $563.9 and Oct 15 high $568.6, now support; Oct 28 low $560.5
